_comment: Credential-free subset of the approved provider schema used for offline checks (WS1-04). Provider/version measured on the demo VM gate (tofu init installed openstack v3.4.0, signed). Attribute names follow the provider's documented resources; tofu validate on the VM is the authoritative check.
